new: Each circle can be walked into or ask first on its own: the headset menu's Circles tab has This circle under the room's switch, and the page's Shared dialog a button in each circle's row.
A circle with no setting of its own follows the room's switch; one set on its own keeps its way whatever the switch says. The lobby is walked into as ever.
With some circles of each kind, the welcome and the menu say both: walk in, or point at a circle and press.
test: In a room that asks first, go into a circle (Go in) and set This circle to walk in; walk out and back in: it enters by walking, and shows its ring.
The other circles still ask and show no ring; press This circle until it says As the room and it asks again.
From a laptop's Shared dialog, switch a circle's button and watch the headsets follow.
Press Go in on another circle while standing in a walked-into one: you should not be pulled back until you step out of it.
untested: Everything on a real headset: the new menu row, rings coming and going, walking into a mixed room.
The Circles tab is one row taller, so its People list shows one fewer person before the count.
